article.name: Citra Decision System

contact.note: The official pinned README publishes contact@citra-ai.com in its contact/about sections.

article.summary: Citra records officer corrections in an evidence ledger, consolidates compatible evidence into scoped clauses, and retrieves those clauses to inform later decision recommendations. This is a source-based review, not a measured evaluation.

who_what.text: Citra is a decision application platform whose learned-memory feature captures officer corrections as evidence-backed clauses used in later recommendations.

architecture.text: Corrections are stored in a MongoDB-backed ledger as pending evidence. Consolidation clusters compatible corrections, authors a concise clause, and preserves correction IDs as provenance.
Clauses carry tenant, app, modality, task type, scope facets, text, support and dissent officers, provenance IDs, performance counters, status, version/history, and relation fields.
The reader selects and formats clauses for analysis prompts and returns clause IDs for traceability. Documented design places SOP policy above learned judgement.

behavior.text: Write: corrections append to the evidence ledger. A background consolidation pass authors clauses from correction clusters; new clauses require provenance and default to candidate unless the distinct-officer promotion threshold is met.

Update and deletion: reinforcement adds support/provenance; set_status snapshots the previous clause state into history. Underperforming, challenged, quarantined, retired, superseded and other statuses can withhold clauses from retrieval. The reviewed source does not establish general hard-delete or erasure semantics.

Retrieval: the query selects by tenant/app/modality/task, live status, and scope-facet subset. Empty scope matches within the bucket; index-assisted candidate selection and a word budget constrain prompt injection.
Evidence: provenance lookup follows correction IDs to officer rationale, prior agent recommendation, facets, changed fields and, for supported records, decision-time context snapshots.
Scope isolation: bucket keys and facet matching separate logical retrieval contexts. The review did not verify authorization across all call sites or run an isolation workload.

metrics.evidence: Clause retrieval is source-visible, but no judged answerability or abstention workload was run.
The source has correction consolidation and status lifecycles, but no correction accuracy sequence was measured.
Status transitions can withhold clauses; no hard-delete, residual-copy, or post-delete retrieval workload was run.
Tenant/app/task/modality and facet filters are present; no cross-tenant isolation workload was run.
Clauses require provenance and can be traced to corrections, but no evidence adjudication workload was run.
Indexes, bounded candidates, word budgets, counters and logs appear in source; no latency, token, cost, storage or telemetry coverage measurements were collected.

limits.text: The README places officer erasure/re-fold and several memory lifecycle controls under Enterprise Memory+. Do not assume these are community capabilities.
Status history is written by set_status, but record_dissent updates fields directly; the reviewed implementation does not show a single append-only audit path for every mutation.
The inspected code does not establish universal hard deletion, backup erasure, all authorization boundaries, retention behavior, or concurrent consolidation guarantees.
This source inspection does not establish runtime quality, isolation, latency, costs, storage efficiency, or behavior under production workload.

benchmark.text: Benchmark status is not_run. No Citra runtime, tests, or benchmark workloads were executed.
